Our analysis

Of the 51 city cars in our comparison, the Fiat 500e is the 13th most expensive to own.

Its biggest cost is depreciation: €19,435 over 5 years, 75% of the total.

A full charge of its 42 kWh battery costs about €7 at home, and 100 km about €2.39.

FAQ

How much does a Fiat 500e cost per month?

About €435 a month at 15,000 km a year over 5 years, including depreciation, energy, insurance, servicing and road tax. That's €0.348 per km.

How much does it cost to charge the Fiat 500e?

A full charge of its 42 kWh battery costs about €7 at home at €0.15/kWh and €21 at a public charger at €0.49/kWh.

Which DGT label does the Fiat 500e have?

The ZERO label.
